Tehseen Poonawalla Announces 'Gaadi March' Against E20 Policy With Five Major Demands To Centre
articles.description: Tehseen Poonawalla has announced a "Gaadi March" on July 31 to protest the Centre's E20 fuel blending policy. The march will begin at India Gate and head towards Parliament Street in New Delhi. Poonawalla has demanded the retail sale of pure E0 petrol at Rs 90 per litre, E20 at Rs 78 per litre, mandatory availability of E10 fuel for compatible vehicles, complete public disclosure of E20 policy documents, and accountability from Union Ministers Nitin Gadkari and Hardeep Singh Puri over alleged public inconvenience.
